bundle.scope: Production minified component-only ESM bundles, React external. Actual baseline Button versus wrapped runtime Button. JS bytes exclude external React, baseline CSS and network overhead. This tests a dedicated component entry, not a future public package root barrel.

soak.scope: Bounded runtime Goober SSR memory/cardinality diagnostic, separate from prior static-CSS evidence. Fresh process for each arm/theme mode. Alternating actual chat/dashboard; four concurrent streaming SSR drains. Natural snapshots immediately before explicit GC, warm/interval/terminal retained samples after GC. Unique themes deliberately grow input cardinality, separating dynamic cache risk from finite-theme steady-state. Not a production leak-free certification.

baseline.interpretation: Cardinality diagnostic; examine per-checkpoint trend, not an overall leak-free boolean

runtime.interpretation: Cardinality diagnostic; examine per-checkpoint trend, not an overall leak-free boolean
